id: title:aspicer:read flag keys from the map in json functions on events json

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HogQL query capabilities to extract feature flag values and status directly from event JSON, supporting dashboard and retention queries without requiring backend lookups.
review.reason: The change implements HogQL AST transformations and documentation for extracting feature flags from event JSON, including native and legacy schemas. This expands HogQL's query capabilities, allowing users to retrieve flag state and values directly in retention and cohort queries. The implementation preserves compatibility with existing event schemas, supporting broader query use. P

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and implementation for HogQL JSON extraction of feature flags, distinguishing native and legacy event schemas, and preserves compatibility with existing JSON functions.
observations.code_quote: A HogQL JSON function on `events_json` whose first key is `$feature/<key>`, `$active_feature_flags` or `$feature_flags` reads the flags map directly instead of the rebuilt document, also when the document is `toString(properties)`.
